# GitHub repository settings

**Description:** Experimental Tk replacement in Zig, on the ztcl interpreter. The plan has a GPU renderer, CSS styling, and no third-party runtime dependencies. Early work: no release yet.

**Website:** https://beetlebug.org/ztk/
